title: i18n(plugin-sharing): ship the assignment rule object in all eleven platform languages
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D7v5H7BaFmL7sUCoN7tSxhm)_

domain:server#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cya5ej5GQV86RPbRPK

Part of #30512 — a follow-up to package 8 (`@objectstack/plugin-sharing`, #30767): the assignment rule object `sys_assignment_rule`, which #30760 added to this package after #30767 landed. It folds in the translations #30066 owed for that object (landing note 6677585327), so no separate card is needed. The card stays open: settings and platform-objects follow, and the last PR of the series makes the bundle check read the platform locale table.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 新对象「分配规则」(`sys_assignment_rule`) 的名称、说明、字段名与帮助、两组选项（分配给：队列 / 用户；选择成员：轮流 / 负载最少）和「按对象」视图名，补上英文以外全部 10 种语言（简中、日、西 + 繁中、阿、法、巴葡、俄、德、韩），每种 30 条。
- **为什么改：** #30760 加了这个对象，但没进本包的抽取配置，所以没有任何翻译；用任何非英文语言的管理员打开「设置 → 分配规则」都看到英文。本 PR 把它加进抽取配置，从此 `check:i18n` 也覆盖它。
- **风险与回滚：** 只改抽取配置的对象列表、与之同步的归属测试清单（一行）和翻译数据，不动逻辑、schema、接口；其它 5 个对象的译文一字未改。选项「队列」「用户」沿用各语言在队列、共享对象上的同一个词，「收件人类型叫法一致」的测试照常通过。回滚即撤 PR。
- **先看：** `scripts/i18n-extract.config.ts`（对象列表多了 `SysAssignmentRule`）和 `src/translations/bundle-ownership.test.ts`（同步加一行），再抽看任一语言 `TAG.objects.generated.ts` 的 `sys_assignment_rule` 段。
- **两分钟验证：** `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --filter=sharing` 输出 `plugins/plugin-sharing in sync`；`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing test` 全绿。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `scripts/i18n-extract.config.ts` lists `SysAssignmentRule` beside the five objects it already extracts, so the repo's own `os i18n extract --fill=default --source-hashes` writes its 30 leaves into `en.objects.generated.ts` and every locale bundle, and `check:i18n` covers them from this PR on.
- The 30 leaves (label, plural label, description, the field labels and help, the `recipient_type` options `queue` / `user`, the `strategy` options `round_robin` / `least_loaded`, and the `by_object` view) are translated in `zh-CN`, `ja-JP`, `es-ES`, `zh-Hant`, `ar`, `fr`, `pt-BR`, `ru`, `de` and `ko`.
- Each locale reuses its existing vocabulary: the `queue` / `user` options read exactly as on `sys_sharing_rule` and `sys_queue_member`, "Organization", "Name", "Display Label", "Description", "Object", "Active" and "By Object" read as on `sys_sharing_rule`, and the object's name follows the word each locale's `sys_queue` help already uses for assignment rules (for `zh-CN` and `ja-JP` also the Setup menu entry #30760 added).
- The `load` help names the `least_loaded` option by its translated label in each locale, and both expression examples (`record.priority == "high"`, `record.status != "closed"`) stay byte-identical.

## Tests

- `bundle-ownership.test.ts` (ADR-0029 D8) lists the objects the extract config owns and is red when the two lists differ; `sys_assignment_rule` is added to it, the one line this config change requires (without it the package suite fails: "bundle carries objects this package's extract config does not own").
- `recipient-vocabulary-consistency.test.ts` already scans every object of every locale, so the new object is held to "one option key, one rendering per locale" with no edit.
- No other test changes.

## Acceptance notes

- **Quality bar (#17508 / PR #19345):** every leaf written for the reader; placeholders, code spans and identifiers byte-identical, checked mechanically per leaf against `en` (key set, `{{holes}}`, `{holes}`, backtick spans, angle tokens: all ten locales OK, zero diffs; 181 leaves each). Arabic is RTL prose with identifiers and the expression examples left in Latin script. `zh-Hant` was checked against OpenCC's Traditional (Taiwan) conversion: no Simplified-only character in the 30 new strings.
- **Leaves equal to English, on purpose, each recorded by the extractor as a source copy:** `fr` `Description`, `Condition`; `de` `Name`. All are the native words.
- No cross-locale coincidence: `check:i18n-stale-fill` passes with the baseline untouched.
- No string opens with `os ` followed by a lowercase word (`check-cli-command-ids` passes), and the whole "Lint · docs & code guards" lane was run locally before opening.
